_comment: Per-source confidence calibration (raw -> calibrated). IMPORTANT: these tables are a HAND-SEEDED HEURISTIC PRIOR, NOT empirical win-rates. They mildly shrink self-reported confidences toward 0.5 because LLM self-reports and raw ensemble probabilities skew overconfident. The 'confidence' field in an AiAnalysisResponse is therefore a calibrated heuristic, not a measured probability of being right; 'raw_confidence' is the uncalibrated model output. To make this empirical, regenerate the tables from app/backtesting/threshold_analysis.py output (predicted-bucket -> observed win-rate) on your own data, and record that derivation here.
